The issuer shows very weak near-term liquidity (current ratio of 0.35) and high balance-sheet leverage (total liabilities of ~89% of total assets), which increases refinancing and short-term funding risk. While operating performance appears solid (EBIT/operating income of 6,598M on 20,880M revenue), the weak liquidity and leverage profile constrain the credit quality.  

DECISION: B+
